description: This file appears to be a C++ source implementation for the DobbyContainer interface. It defines a class with methods for managing containers—starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, getting info, and handling events. It interacts with external proxies and services, and contains logic for container lifecycle management within an embedded or containerized environment.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: Class encapsulating container management operations including initialization, start, stop, pause, resume, info retrieval, and event handling.
